notes.EE: Estonia: tax-free allowance of €700 a month, 2% to the second pension pillar.
notes.LV: Latvia: tax-free allowance of €550 a month, 10.5% social insurance on income up to €105,300 a year.
notes.LT: Lithuania: tax-free allowance of up to €747 a month that shrinks as pay grows; 19.5% contributions (without the second pension pillar, whose members pay 3% more).
